text: This report recommends that the name “North Star Way” be approved to identify an existing public lane located south of Queen Street East extending east of St Paul Street. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/ .
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name “North Star Way” for an existing public lane located south of Queen Street East extending east of St Paul Street.
